name: DaYan TengYun 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The DaYan TengYun 3x3 Magnetic is widely regarded as DaYan’s best 3x3 speed cube to date. This magnetic cube 3x3 delivers a smooth, fast, and slightly scratchy feel, with medium-strength magnets that enhance stability, control, and overall a great 3x3 speed cube performance.
